open_points.subject: startup recovery of a run containing both a ready element and a still-waiting element
open_points.text: “A run derived `running` is advanced with `runs`' own advance, which reaches every ready element while other elements still wait (A13 rule 8) …; a run derived still waiting is not advanced”
open_points.question: When recovery finds at least one ready element but another element still waits, does `run_graph` derive the run as `running` so `runs` advances the ready element, or as `awaiting_approval`/`pending` so recovery does not advance it?
options: Ready takes precedence: derive `running` and advance every ready element while retaining the other waiting points.
Waiting takes precedence: derive `awaiting_approval` or `pending` and do not advance any ready element during recovery.
open_points.default_guess: Ready takes precedence: derive `running`, advance all ready work, and rest as waiting only when no ready element remains.
